name: oxfordra-website
description: Build and verification tooling for oxfordra.net. `npm run build` assembles the dist/ publish directory (the same command netlify.toml runs); `npm run verify` is the full pre-merge gate that .github/workflows/ci.yml executes. Also pins netlify-cli to a tested version so deploys resolve a local install instead of npx's evictable cache.

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run verify:jsonld && npm run test:unit && npm run test:site && npm run test:shim && npm run test:functions
